name: Check Device List Unchanged
desc: 比對目前裝置清單與參考檔（仿 VKEStress DeviceCheck）; 有差異（裝置消失/狀態改變）會列出差異並失敗, 停止循環。要重建基準: 刪除 se_devices.txt。
cmd: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$f='%~dp0se_devices.txt'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)){Write-Host '[ERROR] No reference list - run Save Device Reference List first.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 3}; $a=Get-Content -LiteralPath $f; $b=@(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Sort-Object InstanceId | ForEach-Object { $_.InstanceId + '=' + $_.Status }); $d=@(Compare-Object $a $b); if($d.Count -gt 0){Write-Host '[FAILED] Device list changed:' -ForegroundColor Red; $d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host; exit 1}; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] Device list unchanged.' -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0"
display: compare the device list with the saved reference
